proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ A B C D hAC hs hang
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hBA : B ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  have hDC : D ≠ C := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  have hsgn : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle B A C).sign = (EuclideanGeometry.oangle D C A).sign := by
    have h1 := AffineSubspace.SOppSide.oangle_sign_eq_neg (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) hs
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rotate_sign A D C, h1, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rev C A B, Real.Angle.sign_neg,
      EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rotate_sign B C A, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rotate_sign A B C]
  have hoa := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_of_angle_eq_of_sign_eq hang hsgn
  have hu : B -ᵥ A ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hBA
  have hv : C -ᵥ D ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hDC.symm
  have hw : C -ᵥ A ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hAC.symm
  unfold EuclideanGeometry.oangle at hoa
  rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C D, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C A, Orientation.oangle_neg_neg] at hoa
  have hz := Orientation.oangle_add (Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation (R := ℝ) (M := V) (ι := Fin 2)) hu hv hw
  rw [hoa] at hz
  have hray := (Orientation.oangle_eq_zero_iff_sameRay _).mp (add_eq_right.mp hz)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrv⟩ := hray.exists_pos_left hu hv
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev, ← hrv]
  exact (Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq (IsUnit.mk0 _ hr.ne') _).symm
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (A B C D : P), A ≠ C → (line[ℝ, A, C]).SOppSide B D → EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = EuclideanGeometry.angle D C A → (line[ℝ, A, B]).Parallel line[ℝ, D, C]
